## Summary

Chibueze Felix Anyanwu (also written Chibueze Felix) is a senior mobile engineer whose work
centres on payments: EMV contact and contactless flows, NFC, POS terminal SDKs, offline
transaction queuing and the consumer fintech apps built on top of them. He also builds Go and
Spring Boot services, and adds LLM-backed features to mobile products.
